thesis: An anomaly protocol must discriminate models, preserve genuine independence and reward justified refusal to decide.
role: Propose controlled laboratories and public accountable testing.

ideas.statement: Specify dimensionless phenomena, concrete rivals, independent instruments and code, preregistered predictions and held-out confirmation.
Artificial worlds should separate fixed rules, effective regimes, evolving parameters, external changes and sensor faults, without generator shortcuts.
Observationally equivalent controls test whether detectors falsely claim certainty; underdetermination can be success and conclusions must stay at their evidence level.

objectionsAndQualifications.statement: The laboratory is proposed rather than performed; simulation hypotheses never justify harming people to provoke a reaction.

audit.notes: Complete batch read; headings and navigation excluded from idea ranking.
